evals.prompt: Review docs/architecture/ in this repo and create a new docs/architecture/deployment-flow.md plus docs/architecture/deployment-flow.html for the Azure DevOps to GKE deployment workflow. Match the existing look and feel, keep the HTML standalone, and include static plus animated modes.
evals.expected_output: A paired Markdown and self-contained HTML architecture document with sidebar steps, Canvas static overview, animated flow controls, and a technical sequence view.

evals.prompt: Generate an interactive architecture HTML page for a semantic router pipeline with offline indexing and runtime routing phases. It should be usable by opening the file directly, without npm, Tailwind, Font Awesome, Mermaid CDN, or GSAP.
evals.expected_output: A single HTML file with inline CSS/JS, no required external dependencies, phase-aware sidebar, Canvas diagram, animated route playback, and a copyable technical diagram/source view.

evals.prompt: Update the architecture docs after adding a new Context Injector component between the agent and Neo4j. Keep the Markdown and HTML synchronized and make sure every animated step references a valid node id.
evals.expected_output: Updated Markdown and HTML docs where the new component appears in the static diagram, sequence steps, sidebar, and technical view with no broken node references.
